summary: Medical Roster feature testing complete. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified: Medical Roster tab visible and functional with 87 cadets displayed, stats bar showing correct counts (Total=87, Allergies=19, Anaphylaxis=1, OTC=81, Rx Meds=0, Incidents=0, Critical=4), filter buttons working, cadet detail sheet opening with all sections (allergies, OTC, medications, incidents).
seed_data_creation: Using existing data: 31 allergy records, 96 OTC approval records, 87 cadets with health data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Medical Roster feature fully implemented and tested. The roster displays all cadets with any health data (allergies, OTC approvals, medications, incidents). Stats bar shows quick counts. Filter buttons filter the roster. Clicking a cadet row opens a detailed health profile sheet. Backend endpoints: GET /api/health/medical-roster returns array of 87 cadets, GET /api/health/cadet/{participant_id}/full-profile returns comprehensive health data.
